meta.bands: 1-6급 as NIKL grade them, which is the grading TOPIK 1-6 follows; a word taken at the lowest grade it appears. No frequency tail: Korean frequency lists are of eojeol, with particles and endings attached, not of lemmas.

meta.filtered: Homograph numbers stripped (가다01 → 가다), entries listing several homographs split, and the duplicates merged. Interjections (감탄사) dropped except 안녕, 네, 예, 아니요 and 여보세요, and anything that is not pure Hangul — affixes like -하다 carry a hyphen. Predicates are kept in their 다 form, which the Lexicon needs; the few the list carries without one are dropped.
meta.source: 국제 통용 한국어 표준 교육과정 어휘 목록 (vocabulary of the International Standard Curriculum for Korean), 국립국어원 National Institute of Korean Language, 2017, 1-6급
